faq_heading: Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs schools: your questions answered

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 11 schools with a Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs street address: 10 public schools and 1 independent school. It also shows 1 college or university campus. In that list, 2 alternate programs and 1 online school.
Public schools here are run by School District 78 (Fraser-Cascade). Count by district: School District 78 (Fraser-Cascade): 10.

The list includes alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address, so the totals run higher than the number of neighbourhood schools; they sit under "other public schools and programs" below. The Ministry's own level field also mislabels some secondary schools as elementary, so this page reads the level from the school's name.

If you are buying with a child in mind, the address matters more than the list. A school's catchment decides which children it must take, and districts change catchments and set their own rules for French immersion and other programs. Ask the district about the exact address before you write an offer.
These three communities share one school district, so they share this list.

blocks.text: Licensed childcare in Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs

The Ministry's Child Care Map registry lists 16 licensed childcare facilities with a Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs address: 13 licensed group and 3 licensed family. The registry covers licensed care only. Care that does not need a licence is not listed by address, so a family may find more options than this count suggests. Names and addresses change often, so check the registry before you rely on any one facility.

faq.q: How many schools are in Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 11 schools with a Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs street address: 10 public schools and 1 independent school. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.

faq.q: Which school district covers Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs?
faq.a: Public schools with a Hope, Agassiz and Harrison Hot Springs address are run by School District 78 (Fraser-Cascade).

faq.q: How do I find which school a home is zoned for?
faq.a: Ask the school district to confirm the catchment school for the exact street address. Catchments change, and living near a school does not guarantee a place at it.
